crossRefs.note: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that you will not hold me innocent.
Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
“Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say…

translations.web: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
translations.bsb: ‘I am pure, without transgression; I am clean, with no iniquity in me.
translations.kjv: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity
translations.asv: I am clean, without transgression; I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me:
